conventions.convention: Modules are ordinary non-super left modules with fields expanded as Σ a_(n) z^(-n-1). Module Jacobi uses three specified binomial expansions, and its iterate uses the vacuum algebra's Y rather than Y_M.
A conformal vertex algebra here means CFT type: L(-1)=T, diagonalizable L(0), finite-dimensional nonnegative integer weight spaces, and V_0=C1.
Admissible modules carry a specified nonnegative integer grading with a_(k)M(n) contained in M(n+wt(a)-k-1); morphisms preserve that grading. No diagonalizability of L_M(0) is imposed.
Grading restriction means a direct sum of finite-dimensional generalized L_M(0)-eigenspaces whose occurring weights have real parts bounded below.
Rationality means complete reducibility of every admissible module into simple V-submodules; finite simple labels, C2-cofiniteness, and tensor-category conclusions are separate properties.

Heisenberg normal ordering moves current modes with index less than zero left of modes with index at least zero. The zero mode belongs to the latter part; conformal modes use the shifted expansion Σ L(n)z^(-n-2).

load_bearing.statement: For any complex vector space E and any A∈End_C(E), the displayed normal-ordered fields on F(E,A)=P⊗E give a V-module in the full formal-Jacobi convention. For v∈P_w, its kth mode sends P_d⊗E into P_(d+w-k-1)⊗E, with negative degrees zero.

The oscillator data define a vertex algebra with the displayed normal-monomial fields. With ω=x_1²/2 it is a conformal vertex algebra of CFT type with central charge 1; L(0)=Σ_(r≥1)r x_r∂_(x_r), L(-1)=T, and its weight-d space is P_d with the stated finite monomial basis.

z_0^(-1)δ((z_1-z_2)/z_0) − z_0^(-1)δ((z_2-z_1)/(-z_0)) = z_2^(-1)δ((z_1-z_0)/z_2), with the first term expanded in nonnegative powers of z_2, the second in nonnegative powers of z_1, and the right side in nonnegative powers of z_0.

For A_λ=λI+N on the specified two-dimensional E, F_λ is admissible and grading-restricted generalized, with L_F(0)=D⊗I+(λ²/2)I+λI⊗N. Its generalized weight spaces are P_d⊗E of weights d+λ²/2. It is logarithmic exactly when λ≠0; at λ=0 it is ordinary.

concerns.concern: Fact F8 attributes to def-rational-vertex-algebra the wording “every admissible module is a direct sum of irreducible admissible modules.” The cited Definition instead says “completely reducible into simple V-submodules” and does not require its summands to respect the specified admissible grading. The example's proof actually constructs homogeneous simple admissible summands, so its conclusion is supported; the quotation of the defining convention should be aligned.

seams_checked.note: Checked the foundation page and its formal-field, state-field, and reconstruction suppliers against their consumer uses. Both sides use ordinary complex non-super fields, vectorwise lower truncation, and the same residue/binomial conventions. The Heisenberg vacuum construction verifies reconstruction's locality, creativity, translation covariance, and negative-mode spanning hypotheses. Module Jacobi is proved separately; no conformal grading, rationality, or module-reconstruction conclusion is attributed to the foundation page.
